models.label: U2-Net lightweight (u2netp)
models.description: Salient-object segmentation for general images: the lightweight U-2-Net variant. A 320x320 normalized RGB input produces a single-channel mask; the mask becomes the alpha channel of the output image. Small enough for CPU inference (about 4.6 MB).

upstream.authors: Xuebin Qin, Zichen Zhang, Chenyang Huang, Masood Dehghan, Osmar R. Zaiane, Martin Jagersand
upstream.paper: U^2-Net: Going Deeper with Nested U-Structure for Salient Object Detection, Pattern Recognition 106 (2020) 107404

licence.note: The weights are released in the Apache-2.0 U-2-Net repository as u2netp.pth.

artifact.host_licence: GitHub release asset of the MIT-licensed rembg tool, which publishes its ONNX conversion of the upstream weights. rembg's README states model weights carry their own licences, independent of rembg's MIT licence; the weights licence is U-2-Net's Apache-2.0.
